topics.title: Nintedanib IVT XR – nAMD Termination (Apr HPSC)

background.text: Nintedanib IVT XR was terminated in the April HPSC meeting due to animal toxicity study not supporting Phase 1. China base case was NA. The termination is also reflected in the 2025 Eye Health Key Milestone Overview.
